main: The sound that never left London.
slides.sub: UK Funky. Summer 2008. One scene. No export.
First track: Apple's Dutty Dance. Made on Fruity Loops. Nothing else.

text: Two summers. That was all it took.
slides.sub: 2008. The whole city ran on this rhythm.

text: Almost all ignored by the press.
slides.sub: Lil Silva later produced Adele's record. No one wrote about where he came from.
The philosophy never crossed over. Just the label.
Twenty years later. Every underground floor carries it.

quote: Real scenes live in the producer's room,
slides.note: The people the press ignored built what the world dances to. That never changes.

slides.strobe: The music they ignored became the root of everything.
